text: Binary row measure from OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP; parse it; order carries no rank or chronology): 1 if at least one comment relies on abstract normative principles (general moral, ethical, rights-based, fairness or justice principles stated in general terms, about what ought to be) as the basis of its counter-argument; otherwise 0. A comment resting mainly on specific concrete cases, institutions or empirical facts does not qualify on that basis alone. Ignore text where the OP announces a view change or delta award, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Valid list with no qualifying comment, including an empty list, gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null.
